tfl2025Plan.detail: 2025: no service on most public transport on Christmas Day ('as usual'); a Sunday service on the Tube, buses and trams on Boxing Day, with no Elizabeth line; Christmas Eve services finish early; New Year's Eve services run all night; the Congestion Charge was suspended from 25 December to 1 January; the IFS Cloud Cable Car runs except Christmas Day. Victoria Coach Station, Santander Cycles, taxis and private hire run on Christmas Day.

transport.tfl2026: Not yet published: tfl.gov.uk/christmas-travel redirected to the major-works page on 17 October. The 2025 plan appeared on 2 December.

networkRail2026.detail: As usual, trains will not run on most routes in England on Christmas Day and Boxing Day. London Paddington is closed from Christmas Day for Dolphin Junction and other work in the Thames Valley; services return from New Year's Eve with the Elizabeth line and Heathrow Express resuming to and from Paddington; Great Western Railway cannot use Paddington until Monday 4 January, so long-distance GWR services start and finish at Reading and some divert to Euston. The Great Eastern Main Line is closed for 10 days from Christmas Day for track renewal at Forest Gate, so no Greater Anglia or Elizabeth line trains run through the area until the early hours of Monday 4 January (Liverpool Street side). The railway through Redhill is closed from 20 December to the early hours of Monday 4 January, with buses replacing trains between Reigate, Earlswood and Purley; Brighton and Gatwick Airport services run. National Rail's engineering calendar: https://www.nationalrail.co.uk/engineering-works/.
